To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
for plants, white light is as efficient as high-pressure sodium light, while for humans, high-pressure sodium light is as efficient and appropriate as white LED light.
for a human being and for plants, white LED light of 2700–3000 K is the most appropriate, and it has the highest luminous efficacy and the highest color rendering index.

for a human being and a plant sharing the same light environment white LED light is the most effective, and that the best general-purpose white LED lamps have a color temperature of about 2700  K, Ra > 90 and luminous efficiency of 100  lm/W.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the possibility of using high quality white LEDs in the cultivation of ornamental plants.
the optimization of lighting conditions for the plants and humans sharing a single light source.
a possibility of using white LED light for plants and humans in the closed ecological systems of the future.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the light environment in the cabin of a spaceship should be optimized for a human being, while the plants should share the same light environment.
the best lighting of plants for a human being is the best lighting of a human being for a plant.
the best light sources for plants are those with the highest luminous efficacy and high color rendering index.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the most efficient light for plants is the most efficient light in terms of human needs.
white LEDs with high color rendering indices and a color temperature of about 2700 k are a promising solution for the lighting of plants in a closed life-support system.
white LED light with a high Ra index and a color temperature of about 2700 k is the best choice of artificial lighting for a plant on Earth and in space.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the best light for plants is the one that is best for the human eye.
the color temperature of white LED lamps is a key parameter that should be taken into account for the design of a plant growth system.
the best lighting for humans is also the best lighting for plants, which is a good news for the future of space horticulture.
